title: Gemini vs Claude: Which AI Model Is Better in 2026?
summary: Gemini vs Claude compared on coding, writing, reasoning, context window, and pricing. Which model should you actually use in 2026? Here's the honest answer.
body_markdown: Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 consistently outperform on tasks requiring consistent voice, tone-matching, and following nuanced writing style instructions. Gemini 3.1 Pro produces high-quality writing but tends toward structured, comprehensive outputs. For narrative writing or anything where voice and taste matter — creative copy, long-form content, style-consistent drafting — Claude is the stronger choice. For writing tasks that synthesize across video, images, and documents, Gemini 3.1 Pro has the multimodal advantage.
